shortDescription: US hiring probably stayed solid for a second month in September, with payrolls seen rising 90,000 and the unemployment rate at 4.1%, according to Bloomberg.The report said economic momentum is building even as cost pressures mount.

title: US Jobs Report Seen at 90,000 Payrolls, 4.1% Unemployment
